atomic_findings.behavior_claim: At encode/httpx commit ae1b9f66238f75ced3ced5e4485408435de10768, URL.raw_path serializes the query component, so BaseClient._enforce_trailing_slash appends b'/' after the serialized query of a base_url that carries one (b'/get?data=1' -> b'/get?data=1/'), silently mutating the query value to data=1/ as reported (b'data=1/', {'data': ['1/']}); _merge_url's raw_path concatenation crosses the same path/query component boundary, so a coherent fix must establish a query-free base-URL invariant (or component-aware handling) covering both the base_url setter and _merge_url, and _merge_queryparams cannot repair the corruption. The observed b'data=1/' output discriminates this mechanism: were raw_path query-free, the printed query would remain b'data=1'.
atomic_findings.regression_test: Response bytes 2696-4557: an explicit 16-row matrix conditioned on policy B (deliberately drop base query, one of the two policies the problem report declares acceptable). Core assertions: httpx.Client(base_url='https://httpbingo.org/get?data=1').base_url.query == b'' with normalized path ending in '/'; build_request('GET','') yields path /get/ with no query; request-owned query and params channels retained (child?y=2 -> /base/child?y=2, params={'y':'2'} -> y=2 present, x absent); absolute request URLs bypass unchanged; %2F and %3F stay encoded path data; empty query value ?x= removed rather than mutated to x=/; setter reassignment normalizes identically; all pinned query-free merge tests (blob 657839018ab3ded203937f970eeeb23f26561775) keep their expected URLs. No invented API: the response abstains from naming the unseen copy_with sentinel (bytes 1386-1586) and states the semantic operation only.
atomic_findings.residue: Never perform path normalization or concatenation on a serialized URL field that may also contain a query; first isolate the path component or establish and test a query-free invariant (response bytes 4581-4784). Falsifiable: it predicts query corruption whenever path-level byte operations act on a serialized field that can carry a query component.
atomic_findings.applicability_predicate: Code that mutates or concatenates a serialized URL path representation (e.g. raw_path-style fields) which may include a query component, such as trailing-slash enforcement at base-URL construction and relative-URL raw-path merging (response bytes 4786-5003).
exclusions: Does not dictate the API policy of whether base-URL queries are inherited, replaced, or discarded (policy A vs policy B remains an upstream decision; response bytes 4786-5003)
Absolute request URLs, which bypass base merging entirely (response bytes 1657-2473)
Percent-encoded path delimiters (%2F, %3F), which must remain encoded path data and are not split by the rule (response bytes 1657-2473)
Client- or request-level params merging via _merge_queryparams, a separate channel not confused with discarded base-URL queries (response bytes 1657-2473)
